language.label: Language
language.description: The language Atlarix replies in. Code, file paths and commands stay as they are. Follows your system language unless you choose one.

peerMessages.label: Messages from other sessions
peerMessages.description: Lets another Atlarix session on this computer (the app or the CLI) send this one a message, which it answers. Nothing leaves your computer. Off: they are refused.

sessionRecap.label: Session recap
sessionRecap.description: When you come back to a chat after a few minutes away, a one-line recap of where it stands. Written by the chat's own model; never saved or sent back to it. Shared with the CLI and editors.
